name.description: the banner id, webhook name, certificate name, access label or backup id to change; for integrations servicenow or infoblox

secret_file.description: path of a file (mode 600) holding the one secret the action needs

secret_env.description: name of an environment variable holding the secret (instead of secret_file)

definition.description: the body for the area and action; see the SKILL.md table

confirm.description: webhook delete: the exact name; certificates apply: the word apply; backups cancel: cancel; backups delete: the id; access label delete: the name
